paragraphs.text:
“No!” Sylvia rasps. Her face is the misshapen echo of a girl from 
long  ago,  analyzing  a  thorny  paper  in  a  Miskatonic  tutorial 
room. But her voice is that of a demon. “Come no closer. It is in 
me and I will take you. Run! I… crave...”

You glance at Norman. To your surprise, he speeds away in 
blind terror. If you hesitate, you may never find him again.

To try to talk Sylvia out of her madness, go to 306. To try to shoot 
her, go to 301. To pursue Norman, go to 338.
